description.short: AIGoGo prospecting: profiles, qualified prospects, outreach and outcomes.
description.full: Hijojo researches each AIGoGo OpCo, finds a small number of evidenced, qualified prospects, sends individually relevant introductions that pass independent QA, follows up once and hands engaged replies to Mark. In Copilot you can see profiles, prospects, evidence, QA verdicts and outcomes, add an OpCo, record feedback and halt sending.
